kurz: Fresh fish smells of the sea. The typical fishy smell only develops when bacteria break down substances in the flesh.
bild_im_kopf: Like milk that only smells sour after a few days: the smell shows the age.

ursachen.warum: Sea fish contains an odourless substance that bacteria break down into strong-smelling trimethylamine. The older the fish, the more of it.
fix: Buy fresh and cook the same day

ursachen.warum: Warmth makes the bacteria work faster.
fix: Store on ice in the coldest part of the fridge

ursachen.titel: The smell clings to hands and pan
ursachen.warum: Trimethylamine is a weak base. Acid such as lemon binds it and softens the smell.
fix: Wash hands with lemon or vinegar

q1.frage: Did the fish already smell strong when unwrapped?

q2.frage: Was it in the fridge for more than a day?
